summary: Official MassChallenge pages identify an active 2026 UK Early Stage Accelerator cohort running June 23-October 29, 2026; applications closed April 15, 2026.

proposed_event.name: MassChallenge UK Early Stage Accelerator 2026
proposed_event.description: Hybrid zero-equity accelerator for high-potential startups with mentoring, partner access, and non-dilutive prizes.

dates.date_range_text: Applications closed April 15, 2026; programme runs June 23-October 29, 2026.

sources.title: United Kingdom - MassChallenge
sources.supports: Official page states the 2026 UK Early-stage Accelerator application deadline was extended to April 15, the programme runs June 23 to October 29, is based in East London, focuses on AI & Autonomy, Cybersecurity, and Foodtech/Agtech while accepting any industry, and offers hybrid activity in London, Lausanne, and online.

sources.title: MassChallenge UK Accelerator 2026 - Launch
sources.supports: Official event page confirms the 2026 MassChallenge UK Early Stage Accelerator launch on June 23, 2026 at Royal Docks Centre for Sustainability, London, and describes the 80-startup cohort.

sources.title: All Programs - MassChallenge
sources.supports: Official programs page describes MassChallenge programs as zero-equity, competition-based accelerators with mentor access, resources, and cash or in-kind prizes.

notes: Applications are not currently open as of 2026-06-09 because the official UK page gives April 15, 2026 as the deadline.
The generic MassChallenge programs page points founders to current/upcoming programs; the UK 2026 cohort is the clearest active dated accelerator record found on official MassChallenge pages.
Foodtech/Agtech was not mapped because the provided taxonomy lacks a food/agriculture sector value; general was included alongside ai and security.
